Backend auth.py: /api/auth/me/permissions endpoint (lines 322-352) returns role_slug AND role_info (name, slug, color) from roles collection
Frontend DashboardLayout.js: displayRoleName uses roleInfo?.name from PermissionsContext with fallback to hardcoded labels (line 336)
Frontend MainSiteDashboardLayout.js: Same pattern - displayRoleName uses roleInfo?.name (line 342)

bug_1.description: Custom role name doesn't appear in header - showing blank/undefined
bug_1.root_cause: Frontend was using hardcoded roleLabels which returned undefined for custom roles like 'news_admin'
bug_1.fix_applied: Frontend now uses roleInfo.name from PermissionsContext with fallback to hardcoded labels

bug_2.description: User gets 'failed to load shows' error because news_admin role had no permissions defined in roles collection
bug_2.root_cause: The news_admin role slug was used in main_site_users but no corresponding role document existed in the roles collection
bug_2.fix_applied: Added news_admin to DEFAULT_ROLES and created migrate_create_missing_roles startup migration that creates role documents for missing role slugs
